( 01 — MY STORY )

Still becoming.
Deliberately curious.

I'm not here to pretend I have it all mapped out. I'm a CSE student learning through the useful, messy work of making things — one project, event, and new idea at a time.

Right now, I'm focused on web development, JavaScript, backend learning, and the MERN stack. I enjoy turning unfamiliar concepts into practical experiments and learning alongside people who are equally curious.

Outside of code, I'm drawn to hackathon energy, community work, photography, and conversations about where technology can go next.

01 / FEATURED PROJECT

CYPHER 4.0 · TEAM ALPHA

LaunchX

AI-POWERED WEBSITE BUILDER CONCEPT

With Team Alpha, I helped build an e-commerce builder for shopkeepers and small businesses. It brings store creation, visual editing, product and order management, and AI-assisted workflows into one project.

Built with JavaScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Mongoose. My role: Team member. Team Alpha reached the top 20 from 80+ teams and progressed to Round 2.

Visit LaunchX ↘View repository ↘
02 / BACKEND PROJECT

Email automation
with Nodemailer

Built a Gmail-based email sender with Node.js, Nodemailer, dotenv, and an HTML welcome-email template. The project uses environment variables and explores attachments and embedded images.

View repository ↘
03 / JAVASCRIPT PROJECT

Infinite
Scroll

Built a scrolling feed that fetches posts dynamically with the JavaScript Fetch API. It detects when readers near the page bottom, prevents duplicate requests, and renders new posts into the DOM.

View repository ↘
